transformConvention: canvasX = sourceX * scale + offsetX; canvasY = sourceY * scale + offsetY
units: source and canvas coordinates are pixels; scale is uniform in both axes
policy: Exactly one fixed scale and translation per animation during playback. No per-frame resizing, repositioning, warping, or interpolation during playback. 4a source-frame registration was corrected with lossless integer translations recorded in its sourcePositionCorrections.

review.method: First two and last two frames of every available clip visually reviewed on contact sheets; all frame alpha bounds checked for canvas containment. Uniform transforms fitted across authored graph adjacency using endpoint head width, silhouette height, head-center position, and baseline. Transformed seam comparisons visually reviewed.
review.measurementDetails: Geometry uses alpha ≥32. Head width/center use the upper 60% of the alpha silhouette, filtered for yellow watercolor pigment (R>130, G>100, R-B>35, G-B>15). All endpoint pair equations use equal weight; head width and silhouette height are normalized by 290 and 489 source pixels, with 1a scale fixed at 1.4. X/Y offsets fit endpoint head centers and baselines. Canvas expanded to include ALL nonzero alpha across every frame, including alpha 1–7 speckles in 4a.
limitations: Uniform clip-wide transforms reduce canvas/scale seams but cannot alter authored character proportions, eye/wing poses, or internal drawing drift.
The 2b seated-to-standing drawings change head-to-body proportion; its transform is a best-fit compromise across both incoming and outgoing neighbors.
4a ends in fading smoke and an empty frame; its scale is determined from standing entry, while full-motion bounds determine canvas padding.
Missing states have identity values only as placeholders and must not be treated as calibrated. Re-review after replacing animation frames; sample hashes/counts identify stale calibration.

updates.method: First two and last two frames visually reviewed against adjacent calibrated standing/sitting clips. New transforms use the existing head-width/silhouette-height least-squares metric; existing transforms and canvas were held fixed. Every source frame checked for nonzero-alpha canvas containment.

All 27 source frames visually reviewed; duck leg shafts, repeated cloud outlines, and sparkles used to correct positional drift with integer translations. Shared-canvas first-two-frame mean entry head center and baseline preserved. Exact RGBA values and total alpha preserved for every nontransparent source pixel; no clipping, resampling, or size changes.

Endpoint contact sheets visually reviewed; end-pose-only uniform least-squares scale fit (head width /406, silhouette height /685), then head-center and baseline registration to 1b and 3a. All-frame alpha containment checked. Source PNGs unchanged.
Endpoint contact sheets visually reviewed; uniform scale, head-center and baseline registration across 1a → 7a → 7b → 7c → 1a. All-frame alpha containment checked; source PNGs unchanged.
Reviewed endpoint contact sheet, uniform head/baseline registration and all-frame containment; originals unchanged.
Reviewed endpoint contact sheet, uniform head/baseline registration and all-frame containment; 6c fitted across entry and exit seams; originals unchanged.

1a.notes: Reference standing pose. Preserve this clip's authored motion; reference mean head center and ground baseline map to canvas anchor.

1b.notes: Aligned across 1a↔1b and 1b→1c/4a. Its standing silhouette is slightly narrower than 1a; a uniform fit preserves that source-model difference.

1c.notes: Aligned across 1a/1b→1c and 1c→1a. Waving/bouncing in the penultimate frame is authored motion and is not individually recentered.

1d.sourceInventoryHashMethod: SHA256 of compact JSON array of {file,sha256}, naturally ordered, with sorted object keys.
1d.notes: Aligned to fixed 1a/1b/1c transforms at incoming pet edges and outgoing 1a/1c edges. Petting has an authored tilted head, bent torso and shorter silhouette; one clip-wide transform preserves this pose and its flutter marks instead of stretching it to a neutral standing height.

2a.notes: Aligned standing entry to 1a and sitting exit to 3a. Ground line and source canvas remain intact; all frames share this transform.

2b.notes: One compromise fit aligns sitting entry from 3a/3b and standing exit to 1a. Source head-to-body proportions change across the clip; residual seam differences cannot be removed by a single uniform transform.

3a.notes: Aligned to sitting exit of 2a and to 3b/2b. Only three unique frames exist, so first-two and last-two samples overlap at 3a0001.png.

3b.notes: Aligned across 3a↔3b and 3b→2b. The look/lean motion and its slight end-frame height variation are retained.

3c.sourceInventoryHashMethod: SHA256 of compact JSON array of {file,sha256}, naturally ordered, with sorted object keys.
3c.notes: Aligned to fixed sitting 3a/3b transforms at incoming pet edges and outgoing 3a edge. The excited head tilt, flapping wings and gesture strokes are retained with one clip-wide scale and offset.

4a.notes: Standing entry aligned to 1a/1b. Final frames are intentionally fading smoke/sparks and then empty, not a standing scale reference. Canvas padding retains the raised wing, smoke, and even very faint nonzero-alpha source speckles. Source positions stabilized on 2026-11-19; clip placement and calibration fingerprints refreshed after whole-pixel translations.
4a.sourceInventoryHashMethod: SHA256 of UTF-8 lines filename:sha256 followed by newline, ordered by filename.

sourcePositionCorrections.method: Integer translations anchored to grounded leg shafts while the duck is visible, then shared cloud contours and sparkles. No scaling, resampling, redrawing, or alpha changes. All nontransparent pixels retained.
sourcePositionCorrections.canvasPadding: Common upward translation of 8 pixels prevents clipping faint bottom-edge speckles when correcting the two raised smoke-entry frames; clip placement compensates for the new first-two-frame mean position.

4b.sourceInventoryHashMethod: SHA256 of UTF-8 lines filename:sha256 followed by newline, ordered by natural filename.
4b.notes: First two and last two frames visually reviewed. End pose aligned to 1b's first-two-frame mean head size/height, head center, and baseline. One fixed clip-wide transform; entry movement/cropped peek and source pixels retained. Full clip alpha bounds fit the existing canvas.

timeout.notes: Hidden timeout has no sprite or scale.
